finals_source: winner only from the graded lock receipts data/snapshots/*_games_open.json (28 games); scores from data/review.json FINAL rows (25 games); scores from ESPN live, STATUS-gated FINAL (13 games)
rule: only LOCKED cards are graded; a prop leg hits when the market's yards reach the recorded line and a game leg is graded against FINAL scores (moneyline on the winner, spread on the margin against the handicap its selection states, an exact push void); a card is a hit only when every leg hit, a miss when any leg missed, void when something voided and nothing missed, and pending while any leg is unresolved -- an unresolved leg is never a miss
